name: nuxt
readme: Nuxt is a free and open-source framework with an intuitive and extendable way to create type-safe, performant and production-grade full-stack web applications and websites with Vue.js. It provides a number of features that make it easy to build fast, SEO-friendly, and scalable web applications, including: Server-side rendering, static site generation, hybrid rendering and edge-side rendering Automatic routing with code-splitting and pre-fetching Data fetching and state management Search engine optimization and defining meta tags Auto imports of components, composables and utils TypeScript with zero configuration Go full-stack with our server/ directory Extensible with 300+ modules…
